title: Illusioner Tower
description: Adds in a new structure, the Illusioner Tower, with a chest of loot and an Illusioner.
body:
# Illusioner Tower🔮
A simple datapack that implements a simple addition that re-introduces the Illusioner. It adds a new structure in the Illusioner Tower that has both an Illusioner and a loot chest. The chest contains the same loot as a pillager outpost chest. The structure spawns in the same biomes a pillager mansion spawns in, and is a bit a more common than a pillager mansion.

### The Tower has:
- 4x floors
- 1x Loot filled Chest
- 1x Illusioner

### An Image of the Tower
![Here should have been an image of an Illusioner tower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7dd40d95b9eb79ed817265a3ce2ca48c00c2521_0.webp)

## Notes
- It says that it's an experimental feature right now, it still seems to work though.
